title: Cross-validate: waypoint encoding parity
description: Verify Python/Rust/Zephyr produce identical waypoint CBOR
notes: 2026-08-26 Phase-2 audit blocker: acceptance explicitly requires Python/Rust/Zephyr byte-identical waypoint CBOR. Python has an independent canonical consumer at python/tests/coap/test_waypoint_vectors.py and canonical test/vectors/waypoint.json; Rust waypoint.rs is already dirty from closed waypoint implementation/sharing beads but has no waypoint.json consumer. Zephyr has no /waypoints resource, waypoint codec, or waypoint.json consumer under lichen/subsys/lichen or lichen/tests; only Meshtastic adapter_nodedb.c marks waypoint app port unsupported. Required Zephyr beads project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.10.6.1.4 (/waypoints resource + storage), .10.6.1.5 (detail resource), and .10.6.2.3 (receive shared waypoint) remain open. Cross-validation cannot truthfully pass until a production Zephyr encoder/decoder exists. Left open and unclaimed; no files edited.
